name: Auntie Anne's

source.title: Auntie Anne's UK website: menu item pages, Nutrition tab (auntieannes.co.uk/menu/, retrieved 2026-10-08; the pages carry no version date, the menu sitemap was last modified 2026-10-08)

note: Values are for the item or size each page shows (pizza 8 or 14 inch, one to three scoops, regular or large). The pages give no weights and don't say how many nuggets or mini dogs are in a portion, nor which milk is used. Some items print identical values (e.g. Margherita, Farmhouse and Vegetarian pizza). Two- and three-scoop gelato are not listed: the pages print allergens only for one scoop.
